# Coverage HTML Deploy Action

A composite GitHub Action for deploying coverage HTML reports to GitHub Pages (self-contained, no external actions required).

## Purpose

Creates a `.nojekyll` marker and deploys the coverage HTML directory directly to the target branch (typically `gh-pages`). Useful for publishing coverage reports generated by [gcovr-report](.github/actions/gcovr-report/README.md).

## Input parameters (`inputs`)

| Parameter | Description | Required | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| `folder` | Coverage HTML directory (relative to workspace) | No | `htmlcov` |
| `branch` | Target GitHub Pages branch | No | `gh-pages` |
| `target_folder` | Target folder on the Pages branch | No | `.` |
| `nojekyll` | Create `.nojekyll` marker | No | `true` |
| `token` | GitHub token for authentication | No | Runner token |

## Usage example

```yaml
- name: Deploy Coverage HTML
  uses: ai-warevo/<repo>/.github/actions/coverage-html-deploy@6cae36f7fe728c23b1a6170d09d6dace55edea77
  with:
    folder: htmlcov
    branch: gh-pages
```
